definition_en: To feel excited about something that will happen.
example_en: I look forward to seeing you next week.
example_uz: Kelasi hafta siz bilan ko'rishishni intiqlik bilan kutaman.

definition_en: To recover from an illness or a disappointment.
example_en: It took her weeks to get over the flu.
example_uz: Gripdan tuzalishi uchun unga bir necha hafta kerak bo'ldi.

definition_en: To leave the ground (plane); to remove clothing.
example_en: The plane takes off at noon.
example_uz: Samolyot tushda parvoz qiladi.

definition_en: To tolerate something unpleasant.
example_en: I can't put up with this noise any longer.
example_uz: Bu shovqinga boshqa chiday olmayman.

definition_en: To arrive or appear, often unexpectedly.
example_en: He turned up an hour late.
example_uz: U bir soat kechikib keldi.

definition_en: To search for information in a book or online.
example_en: Look up any new word in the dictionary.
example_uz: Har qanday yangi so'zni lug'atdan qarang.

definition_en: To finally agree to something after resisting.
example_en: The children begged until their father gave in.
example_uz: Bolalar otasi yon bergunicha yolvorishdi.

definition_en: To look or behave like an older family member.
example_en: She takes after her mother.
example_uz: U onasiga tortgan.

definition_en: To manage to live with the money or things you have.
example_en: They get by on one small salary.
example_uz: Ular bitta kichik maoshga kun ko'rishadi.

definition_en: To wait for a short time.
example_en: Hold on, I'll check for you.
example_uz: Kutib turing, siz uchun tekshirib ko'raman.

definition_en: To disappoint someone who trusted you.
example_en: Don't let your team down.
example_uz: Jamoangizni umidini puchga chiqarmang.

definition_en: To investigate or examine a problem.
example_en: The manager promised to look into the complaint.
example_uz: Menejer shikoyatni tekshirishga va'da berdi.

definition_en: To invent a story; to become friends again after a quarrel.
example_en: He made up an excuse for being late.
example_uz: U kechikkani uchun bahona to'qib chiqardi.

definition_en: To draw attention to a fact or mistake.
example_en: She pointed out an error in my report.
example_uz: U hisobotimdagi xatoni ko'rsatib berdi.

definition_en: To dress yourself in a piece of clothing.
example_en: Put on your coat — it's cold outside.
example_uz: Paltoyingizni kiying — tashqarida sovuq.

definition_en: To meet someone by chance.
example_en: I ran into an old friend at the market.
example_uz: Bozorda eski do'stimga duch kelib qoldim.

definition_en: To arrive, especially at an event where people expect you.
example_en: Only half the guests showed up.
example_uz: Mehmonlarning faqat yarmi keldi.

definition_en: To solve a problem or organise something.
example_en: We need to sort out the payment issue first.
example_uz: Avval to'lov masalasini hal qilishimiz kerak.

definition_en: To take control of something from someone else.
example_en: A larger company took over the factory.
example_uz: Kattaroq kompaniya zavodni o'z qo'liga oldi.

definition_en: To happen or end in a particular way.
example_en: The rumour turned out to be true.
example_uz: Mish-mish rost bo'lib chiqdi.

definition_en: To support someone; to make a copy of computer data.
example_en: Back up your files every week.
example_uz: Fayllaringizning nusxasini har hafta saqlab qo'ying.

definition_en: To explode; to suddenly become very angry.
example_en: The old bridge was blown up in the war.
example_uz: Eski ko'prik urushda portlatib yuborilgan.

definition_en: To end a romantic relationship.
example_en: They broke up after five years together.
example_uz: Ular besh yillik munosabatdan keyin ajrashishdi.

definition_en: To cancel something that was planned.
example_en: The match was called off because of rain.
example_uz: O'yin yomg'ir sababli bekor qilindi.

definition_en: To become less angry or excited.
example_en: Calm down and tell me what happened.
example_uz: Tinchlaning va nima bo'lganini ayting.

definition_en: To register on arrival at a hotel or airport.
example_en: We checked in two hours before the flight.
example_uz: Parvozdan ikki soat oldin ro'yxatdan o'tdik.

definition_en: To become happier or make someone happier.
example_en: Cheer up — things will get better.
example_uz: Ruhingizni ko'taring — hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi.

definition_en: To think of an idea or a plan.
example_en: She came up with a brilliant solution.
example_uz: U ajoyib yechim o'ylab topdi.

definition_en: To reduce the amount of something you use or eat.
example_en: The doctor told him to cut down on sugar.
example_uz: Shifokor unga shakarni kamaytirishni aytdi.

definition_en: To take someone somewhere by car; to fall asleep.
example_en: I'll drop you off at the station.
example_uz: Sizni bekatga tashlab ketaman.

definition_en: To escape; to go somewhere for a rest.
example_en: We hope to get away for a few days in May.
example_uz: May oyida bir necha kunga dam olishga chiqmoqchimiz.

definition_en: To review or examine something carefully.
example_en: Let's go over the plan one more time.
example_uz: Rejani yana bir bor ko'rib chiqaylik.

definition_en: To spend relaxed time with friends.
example_en: We hang out at the park after class.
example_uz: Darsdan keyin bog'da birga vaqt o'tkazamiz.

definition_en: To stay at the same level or speed as others.
example_en: It's hard to keep up with the news these days.
example_uz: Bugungi kunda yangiliklardan orqada qolmaslik qiyin.

definition_en: To continue to something new after finishing or losing something.
example_en: After the failure, he decided to move on.
example_uz: Muvaffaqiyatsizlikdan so'ng u oldinga intilishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: To die — a polite expression.
example_en: Her grandfather passed away last year.
example_uz: Uning bobosi o'tgan yili vafot etdi.

definition_en: To return money that you owe.
example_en: I'll pay you back on Friday.
example_uz: Qarzingizni juma kuni qaytaraman.

definition_en: To put something back in its usual place.
example_en: Put away your toys before dinner.
example_uz: Kechki ovqatdan oldin o'yinchoqlaringizni yig'ishtiring.

definition_en: To start a new hobby or activity.
example_en: He took up swimming at forty.
example_uz: U qirq yoshida suzish bilan shug'ullana boshladi.

definition_en: To put on clothing to see if it fits.
example_en: Can I try on these shoes?
example_uz: Bu oyoq kiyimlarni kiyib ko'rsam bo'ladimi?

translation_uz: gap bilan emas ish bilan ko'rsatmoq
definition_en: What you do matters more than what you say.
example_en: Stop promising — actions speak louder than words.
example_uz: Va'da beraverma — gap bilan emas, ish bilan ko'rsat.

definition_en: To make a bad situation even worse.
example_en: His rude reply only added fuel to the fire.
example_uz: Uning qo'pol javobi faqat olovga moy quydi.

definition_en: To pursue a mistaken idea or blame the wrong person.
example_en: If you suspect me, you're barking up the wrong tree.
example_uz: Agar mendan shubhalansangiz, noto'g'ri yo'ldan izlayapsiz.

definition_en: To avoid saying something directly.
example_en: Stop beating around the bush and tell me the truth.
example_uz: Gapni aylantirmasdan haqiqatni ayting.

definition_en: It is better to do something late than not to do it at all.
example_en: He finally apologised — better late than never.
example_uz: U nihoyat uzr so'radi — hech qachondan ko'ra kech yaxshi.

headword: bite off more than you can chew
definition_en: To try to do more than you are able to manage.
ipa: baɪt ɒf mɔː ðən juː kən tʃuː
example_en: Taking three jobs was biting off more than he could chew.
example_uz: Uchta ishga yollanish u ko'tara olmaydigan yuk edi.

definition_en: To work or study late into the night.
example_en: She burned the midnight oil before the exam.
example_uz: U imtihon oldidan tunlarni bedor o'tkazdi.

headword: by the skin of your teeth
definition_en: Only just; by a very small margin.
ipa: baɪ ðə skɪn əv jɔː tiːθ
example_en: He passed the test by the skin of his teeth.
example_uz: U testdan arang o'tdi.

definition_en: To be upset about something that cannot be changed.
example_en: It's done — don't cry over spilt milk.
example_uz: Bo'lar ish bo'ldi — endi kuyinishdan foyda yo'q.

definition_en: Practical, sensible and modest.
example_en: Despite her fame, she is very down to earth.
example_uz: Shuhratiga qaramay u juda kamtar.

definition_en: Much harder to do than to talk about.
example_en: Just relax? Easier said than done!
example_uz: Shunchaki tinchlanish kerakmi? Aytish oson, qilish qiyin!

headword: every cloud has a silver lining
definition_en: Every difficult situation has a positive side.
ipa: ˈevri klaʊd hæz ə ˈsɪlvə ˈlaɪnɪŋ
example_en: She lost the job but found a better one — every cloud has a silver lining.
example_uz: U ishini yo'qotdi, lekin yaxshirog'ini topdi — har yomonlikda bir yaxshilik bor.

definition_en: To accept the unpleasant consequences of your actions.
example_en: He broke the rules and now must face the music.
example_uz: U qoidalarni buzdi va endi oqibatiga tik boqishi kerak.

definition_en: To suddenly become too nervous to do something planned.
example_en: He got cold feet just before the interview.
example_uz: Suhbatdan sal oldin uning yuragi dov bermay qoldi.

definition_en: To learn how to do something after some practice.
example_en: You'll get the hang of driving soon.
example_uz: Tez orada mashina haydashning epini topib olasiz.

definition_en: To make more effort than is expected of you.
example_en: Good teachers go the extra mile for their students.
example_uz: Yaxshi o'qituvchilar o'quvchilari uchun kutilganidan ortig'ini qiladi.

definition_en: To begin a journey.
example_en: It's getting late — time to hit the road.
example_uz: Kech bo'lyapti — yo'lga tushish vaqti keldi.

definition_en: In the same difficult situation as other people.
example_en: We all failed the test, so we're in the same boat.
example_uz: Hammamiz testdan yiqildik, ahvolimiz bir xil.

definition_en: To join an activity because it has become popular.
example_en: Many brands jumped on the eco-friendly bandwagon.
example_uz: Ko'plab brendlar ekologik modaga ergashdi.

definition_en: To stay cheerful in a difficult situation.
example_en: Keep your chin up — you'll pass next time.
example_uz: Ruhingizni tushirmang — keyingi safar o'tasiz.

definition_en: To learn how to do a new job or activity.
example_en: It took a month to learn the ropes at the new job.
example_uz: Yangi ishda ish sirlarini o'rganish bir oy vaqt oldi.

headword: let the cat out of the bag
definition_en: To reveal a secret by mistake.
ipa: let ðə kæt aʊt əv ðə bæɡ
example_en: He let the cat out of the bag about the surprise party.
example_uz: U kutilmagan bazm sirini oshkor qilib qo'ydi.

definition_en: To tell only the main points of a story.
example_en: To make a long story short, we missed the train.
example_uz: Qisqasini aytganda, poyezdga kechikdik.

headword: off the top of my head
definition_en: Without careful thought or checking the facts.
ipa: ɒf ðə tɒp əv maɪ hed
example_en: Off the top of my head, I'd say fifty people came.
example_uz: Shartta aytganda, ellik kishi kelgan bo'lsa kerak.

definition_en: Extremely happy.
example_en: She was on cloud nine after winning the prize.
example_uz: Mukofotni yutgach uning boshi osmonga yetdi.

definition_en: In a risky situation where trouble is likely.
example_en: After missing three deadlines, he's on thin ice.
example_uz: Uchta muddatni o'tkazib yuborgach, u xavfli ahvolda.

definition_en: Completely unexpectedly.
example_en: Out of the blue, she called me after ten years.
example_uz: Kutilmaganda, u o'n yildan keyin menga qo'ng'iroq qildi.

definition_en: To decide what to do as things happen rather than planning.
example_en: We have no fixed plans — we'll play it by ear.
example_uz: Aniq rejamiz yo'q — vaziyatga qarab ish tutamiz.

definition_en: To joke by telling someone something that is not true.
example_en: Relax, I'm only pulling your leg.
example_uz: Xotirjam bo'ling, shunchaki hazillashyapman.

definition_en: Whatever happens; in any weather.
example_en: The market opens every day, rain or shine.
example_uz: Bozor har kuni, ob-havodan qat'i nazar ochiladi.

definition_en: To understand a meaning that is not stated directly.
example_en: Reading between the lines, I think they're unhappy.
example_uz: Gap tagidagi ma'noga qarasam, ular norozi shekilli.

translation_uz: o'zi haqida gap ketganda kelib qolmoq
definition_en: Said when a person appears just as you are talking about them.
example_en: Speak of the devil — here comes Aziz now!
example_uz: O'zi haqida gapirsak — ana, Aziz kelyapti!

definition_en: To take the attention or praise that belongs to someone else.
example_en: She stole my thunder by announcing her news at my party.
example_uz: U mening bazmimda o'z yangiligini e'lon qilib shuhratimni tortib oldi.

headword: take it with a grain of salt
definition_en: To doubt that something is completely true.
ipa: teɪk ɪt wɪð ə ɡreɪn əv sɔːlt
example_en: Take his stories with a grain of salt.
example_uz: Uning hikoyalariga to'liq ishonavermang.

definition_en: A small visible part of a much larger problem.
example_en: These complaints are just the tip of the iceberg.
example_uz: Bu shikoyatlar muammoning ko'ringan qismi xolos.

translation_ru: и в горе и в радости
definition_en: In good times and in bad times.
example_en: They stayed friends through thick and thin.
example_uz: Ular och-to'qlikda ham do'st bo'lib qolishdi.

definition_en: To admit defeat and stop trying.
example_en: Don't throw in the towel yet — one exam is left.
example_uz: Hali taslim bo'lmang — bitta imtihon qoldi.

definition_en: Time passes very quickly.
example_en: Time flies when you're having fun.
example_uz: Maza qilib yurganingizda vaqt tez o'tadi.

definition_en: To deliberately ignore something you know is wrong.
example_en: The guard turned a blind eye to the broken gate.
example_uz: Qorovul buzilgan darvozani ko'rmaslikka oldi.

definition_en: Uncertain; not yet decided.
example_en: Our travel plans are still up in the air.
example_uz: Sayohat rejalarimiz hali ham noaniq.
